aesthetic_vision: NASA mission ops meets sci-fi terminal meets blockchain dashboard. A highly dense, operator-grade cosmic-tech UI. Deep space indigo base with neon cyan/magenta glowing accents, JSON viewers everywhere, and stark terminal typography.

headings.style: High-tech, squarish, condensed. All major titles, panel headers, and metric numbers must use Rajdhani. Use uppercase with generous tracking (tracking-wider) for small subheadings to mimic terminal readouts.

body.style: Strictly monospaced body text for the ultimate developer/operator console feel.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid Protocol. Highly dense, data-correlation focused. All space must be utilized efficiently.

cards.style: Retro-Futurism Terminal Look. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). 1px border. Dark indigo background. Use neon cyan/magenta borders selectively for active or hovered cards.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-cyan-400 text-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-400 hover:text-black transition-all shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,240,255,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] font-Rajdhani font-bold tracking-wider uppercase
buttons.secondary: bg-[#111322] border border-[#4A4D6B] text-slate-300 hover:border-magenta-400 hover:text-magenta-400 transition-colors font-Rajdhani uppercase tracking-widest
buttons.danger: bg-transparent border border-[#FF003C] text-[#FF003C] hover:bg-[#FF003C] hover:text-white transition-colors uppercase

json_viewer.container: bg-[#05050A] border border-[#111322] p-4 font-JetBrains Mono text-xs overflow-x-auto rounded-sm
json_viewer.interaction: Include 'Copy to Clipboard' icon button in top right. Make keys cyan, strings green, numbers magenta.

badges.style: Small, uppercase, sharply readable tags. text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest px-2 py-1 border rounded-sm

navigation.style: Top header with fixed positioning (z-50). Dark glassmorphism (`bg-[#05050A]/80 backdrop-blur-md`). Bottom border 1px solid cyan-500/20. Must include brand logo (PMOS • WMEU text) and operator login status.

icons.style: Use stroke-width 1.5 to keep them looking sharp and technical. Color them with neon accents when active.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle border color shifts (grey to cyan/magenta) and soft box-shadow glows.
motion_and_interaction.pipeline_animation: When the 15-engine pipeline runs, use a staggered sequence. Active engine pulses cyan. Completed engines turn green.
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus states have a 2px solid cyan ring offset by 2px (bg-black).

hero_background.description: Deep space digital galaxy wallpaper. Use with extreme opacity (bg-black/80) as a backdrop for the Control Deck to give a subtle cosmic feel without overpowering the data.

data_engine_abstract.description: Abstract glowing digital circuitry. Can be used in the Meme Asset Viewer or Rarity Calculator headers as a clipped background overlay.

server_console.description: Curved glass server room. Great for the Debug Dashboard or Governance Panel hero banner.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans. Add the Google Fonts import for Rajdhani and JetBrains Mono in index.css.
Add tailwind configuration for font families: font-sans ('Rajdhani', sans-serif) and font-mono ('JetBrains Mono', monospace).
All functional blocks (Engine Health, Canon Integrity, Timeline) must be wrapped in structural dark cards with 1px borders.
When building the 15-Engine Pipeline visualization, represent it as a grid or sequential flow of nodes. Each node needs clear Idle/Running/Success/Error states.
JSON Viewers are central to this app. Build a reusable component that receives a JSON object and renders it with the specified syntax highlighting colors.
Ensure all interactive elements and major data containers include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="run-pmos-button"`, `data-testid="engine-node-blueprint"`).
Do not use default Shadcn themes. Strip Vercel-like styling and replace it with hard corners, deep black backgrounds, and cyan/magenta neon borders.
Use Recharts (or Shadcn Charts) for the Chart Viewer, but style the lines/bars with neon cyan and magenta strokes over deep indigo grid backgrounds.
